title: John Lear admits he made up Dulce firefight story

tellings.quote: Leer said, "Oh yeah, I made that up." He actually said this,

plain: A well-known tale says American forces fought a gun battle with aliens in an underground base beneath Archuleta Mesa, near Dulce, New Mexico. According to the writer Greg Bishop, John Lear, a pilot who helped spread the story in the early 1990s, later admitted he invented it, telling Bishop plainly, "Oh yeah, I made that up." Bishop relays this while discussing Paul Bennewitz, a New Mexico man whose ideas fed the Dulce legend. If it is so, one of the most famous parts of that legend would go back to one man's invention.
